generator_notes: diy.com is a React Router SPA. None of the captured XHR/fetch responses carry the search results: the only diy.com API hit during a search was /browse-mfe/api/gds-social-proofing, which returns {"products": {}} (just a shell for review counts) and never includes titles. However, the SSR HTML at https://www.diy.com/search?term={query} embeds a complete schema.org ItemList in a <script type="application/ld+json"> tag with @type=ItemList, including each product's name, url, sku, image, description, and offers.price. Adapter fetches that page, extracts the first ld+json script whose @type is ItemList, and projects items. name fields contain HTML entities (&, ", '); the adapter decodes them. No auth, cookies, or rotation headers are required for the public search page. No headers needed to be stripped from a captured XHR (we are not replaying any). Title-overlap with ground truth is 1.0 across all 3 non-errored sample queries (CLS timber, plywood exterior, galvanised hinge). The two errored queries (roofing felt, wood screws 4x40) failed during recording with deadline timeouts and are skipped per spec.
